id: \bRaihan: So it's finally time to decide who's going to move on to the Mastler Class. I'll be the one to face Leon.
en: \bRaihan: So it's finally time to decide who's going to move on to the Mastler Class. I'll be the one to face Leon.
it: \bRaihan: Finalmente è ora di decidere chi passerà alla Classe Master. Sarò io ad affrontare Dandel.

id: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 8. You have entered the Master Class.
en: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 8. You have entered the Master Class.
it: Smart Rotom: In base alle prestazioni, la tua posizione ora è 8. Sei entrato nella Classe Master.

id: The final entrance battle has been completed. You have locked in your place as one of the Trainers competing in the Masters Eight Tournament.
en: The final entrance battle has been completed. You have locked in your place as one of the Trainers competing in the Masters Eight Tournament.
it: L'ultima lotta di qualificazione è terminata. Ti sei assicurato il posto tra gli Allenatori che competeranno nel torneo degli Otto Master.

id: \bRaihan: Crap. I gave it my all, but you're just too tough. Be sure to give Leon a battle he'll never forget.
en: \bRaihan: Crap. I gave it my all, but you're just too tough. Be sure to give Leon a battle he'll never forget.
it: \bRaihan: Accidenti. Ho dato il massimo, ma sei troppo forte. Mi raccomando, regala a Dandel una lotta che non dimenticherà mai.

id: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Professor Cerise:
en: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Professor Cerise:
it: Smart Rotom: Chiamata in arrivo dalla Professoressa Cerise:

id: \bCerise: \PN, can you make your way back to the lab? An unknown Pokémon has been spotted.
en: \bCerise: \PN, can you make your way back to the lab? An unknown Pokémon has been spotted.
it: \bCerise: \PN, puoi tornare al laboratorio? È stato avvistato un Pokémon sconosciuto.
